sources.store: pkg/core/store.go NewStoreInfo preserves metadata; GetMeta returns it; factory.go StoreFactory yields zero value
sources.stats: pkg/core/store_stats.go newStoreStats initializes zero report; updateRawStats replaces raw report; CloneStoreStats deep-clones all fields
sources.existing_tests: TestCloneMetaStore asserts label equality and clone independence; TestNewStore asserts regionScoreV2 order only (executed 1 test); full field/unknown/absence expectations are source-derived, not executed Go differential tests
sources.full_fields: Rust full tests assign each pinned protocol field a distinct nonzero value; preserving raw reports requires identical fields, nested presence, order and map entries; invalid txn range is preserved, validation belongs to consumers

cases.name: defaults_and_presence

cases.name: limits_and_presence
cases.expected: No validation/clamping in metadata/raw report storage. Invalid range and inconsistent capacities retained; None differs from Some(default); duplicate record keys and region IDs retain order; infinities and signed zero retained.
